prompts.title: Clarify Purpose
prompts.template: Rewrite this email so the purpose is immediately clear. Start with the reason for the email, organize the information logically, remove unnecessary words, highlight any requested action, and end with a clear next step. Keep my writing style natural, professional, and friendly without sounding like AI wrote it.

prompts.title: Professional Tone
prompts.template: Rewrite this email to sound confident, respectful, and professional while remaining natural and easy to read.

prompts.title: Friendly & Warm
prompts.template: Rewrite this email so it sounds warm, positive, and personable without losing professionalism.

prompts.title: Short & Clear
prompts.template: Rewrite this email using the fewest words possible while keeping every important detail.

prompts.title: Client / Owner / Customer Reply
prompts.template: Rewrite this email so the customer feels heard and respected. Clearly explain the solution, avoid blame, and end with an invitation to contact me with questions.

prompts.title: Stakeholder / Principal Request Response
prompts.template: Rewrite this response to a principal, owner representative, or campus administrator regarding {{Location}} so the request is acknowledged, the issue and planned action are clear, the expected timing is stated if provided, and any needed access or coordination is identified. Keep the tone professional, helpful, and direct.

prompts.title: Follow Up
prompts.template: Rewrite this as a professional follow-up email. Briefly remind the recipient of the previous communication, explain why I am following up, and ask for an update without sounding pushy.

prompts.title: Grammar Only
prompts.template: Correct grammar, spelling, punctuation, and formatting only. Do not change my wording, tone, or meaning.

prompts.title: Executive Summary (Under 30 Seconds)
prompts.template: Rewrite this email so a busy executive can understand it in less than 30 seconds. Put the purpose first, remove unnecessary details, and end with the action requested.
